newsitem.title: USA: Lubrizol buys lubricant additives company.
newsitem.headline: Lubrizol buys lubricant additives company.

text.p: Lubrizol Corp said Monday it acquired Gateway Additive Co, a South Carolina-based company that develops and supplies performance additives to the metal-working fluids and industrial lubricant markets.
Lubrizol said Gateway had sales of about $10 million in 1996. Lubrizol's fiscal 1996 sales totalled $1.59 billion.

Lubrizol said it will operate Gateway as a separately incorporated unit and merge its own North American metalworking additives business into Gateway. The new operation will be based in Spartanburg, S.C., it said.
